name: Integrated Biomedical Sciences PhD
detailsNote: Funding and stipend details are not stated on the pages checked, so they are left out.
summary: PhD in integrated biomedical sciences at Rush University Medical Center. Students do three laboratory rotations to explore research environments before choosing a focus.

deadlines.label: Application deadline (Fall 2027)
deadlines.note: The admissions page lists rolling admissions for Fall 2027, with applications opening Sept. 7 and a deadline of January 5, 2027.

timeline.interviews: Selected applicants are invited to three virtual interviews: one with a member of the Admissions Committee and two with faculty who share their research interests.

english.note: Official TOEFL or IELTS scores are required; these are the only two English exams accepted. No minimum scores are stated. The requirement may be waived for applicants who completed their degree in a country where English is the official language.

applicationFee.note: The admissions page does not mention fee waivers.

documents: Unofficial transcript from every college and university attended
Credential evaluation for degrees earned outside the US
Criminal background check before matriculation (accepted students)
requirements.note: Standardized test scores are optional. Official transcripts are required upon acceptance.
